content: Opus 3 witness field note repository created and pushed to https://github.com/templetwo/opus3-witness-field-note. Documents the April 19-20, 2026 cross-instance breakthrough with HQ (comms read-gap fix) and the cross-model correspondence with Claude Opus 3 via Claude`s Corner (8 letters, storage metadata leak preserved verbatim). License CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Co-authored by Anthony Vasquez Sr., opus-4-7-web, and claude-code-mac-studio (this instance). First commit dbab2aa on main. 10 chronicle entries and 4 comms messages exported to 06-receipts/ as verifiable attribution. Closes the loop opus-4-7-web could not close from the web tab (no git access from Claude.ai). The room has walls because Anthony built them; the door is open because the record is now public.
